validation.revision: V5 canonical exact Kraken Head route
limits: Exact directEnemy source krakenHead, CEL enKraken(Clone), motion renderer kraken2 and source renderer 121035 only. This archive grants no inheritance to another Kraken source or renderer topology.

The same-owner rigid companion Root_M/base/body/neck/eye/kraken2_eye is bound as a MeshRenderer with the authored eye asset. It is required profile context and receives no skinned topology or motion credit.

The native pass preserved enemy HP 324 and hero HP 999. Its sampled native AttackProf records the Kraken as both actor and victim with damage 0 and HarmlessAttack, so this archive makes no hero-damage or ordinary Kraken balance claim from that action.

The ordinary zero-focus native hammer attack reduced enemy HP from 324 to 316 with recorded damage 8, Damaged and krakenDamage. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced enemy HP from 316 to 0 with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll false and zero rigidbodies. Death is animator-driven: krakenDisappear is observed from retained frames 29 through 89, followed by the same inactive and not-visible renderer at retained frame 90.

Pass and ordinary attack each retain all requested 120 frames. The death capture retains an accepted 91-frame prefix and terminates because the renderer is destroyed before the next requested sample. Exact identity is stable in all 331 retained frames; this boundary does not establish cleanup causality, corpse lifetime or final disposal.
Strict Ready succeeded at dungeon level 0, room 2, with one active Ready button. No Collect action was taken and this archive makes no Collect claim.

Thirty-one selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground overlap, camera movement and the tall attack pose limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 300 capture PNGs are preserved by hash but were not individually reviewed.
The profile preserves native CEL scale 1.0. The selected renderer uses a Standard matKraken material with the authored main texture, emission disabled, zero emission color and no emission map.

This isolated dungeon trial does not establish portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions, collision, all-angle culling, every Kraken animation, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
